verdict.rationale: Insomnia's Design view auto-lints OpenAPI specs showing error type/line/message (insomnia-docs-17), and the Inso CLI can run 'inso lint spec' in CI to fail builds on errors (insomnia-docs-49, insomnia-docs-53), giving a platform-engineer a way to gate specs on validation issues. However, there is no evidence of configurable style/governance rulesets (e.g., custom rule files, organization-wide style guides, or Spectral-like rule configuration) — the linting appears to be basic schema/structural validation rather than customizable governance policy enforcement. Missing for 10: evidence of configurable lint rule files or style-guide customization, evidence of org-level governance policy enforcement, and independent confirmation the lint rules can be tailored beyond basic OpenAPI validity checks.
